name: Plate II: The Pentalpha
description: The pentagram of the Pythagoreans, sign of Hygieia, whose heart holds a smaller star, and that one another, without end. Struck in Lapis Lazuli: ground lapis, the stone of the night sky and of Egyptian heaven. Degree of Neophyte, rank 449 of the folio. “ORDO AB CHAO”: Order out of chaos.
